summary.text: Nader Sayegh is an Assemblymember from Yonkers who sits on the Assembly Education Committee.
His official biography describes a career as a teacher, Yonkers school principal for 30 years, college professor, president of the Yonkers Board of Education and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Sayegh has lived in Yonkers since childhood and grew up on its southwest side with seven siblings, according to his Assembly biography.

He attended Yonkers public schools, earned bachelor's and master's degrees and a doctorate in education, and holds a degree in international affairs from Fairleigh Dickinson University and a Juris Doctor from Pace University.
He has practiced law for over 30 years, with a focus on personal injury, immigration, real estate and criminal law.

In the Assembly he has pressed for changes to the state school funding formula, which the biography says underfunds Yonkers, and his biography lists votes to expand the Excelsior Scholarship and to fund the DREAM Act.
It says he passed measures in 2022 exempting diapers from local sales taxes and requiring electric utilities to add communication and coordination planning to storm restoration plans.
He has been married to his wife, Sana, for over 30 years, and they have five daughters.
